title: This startup pits dealerships against each other to bid on your used car
slides: Your used car gets bids, but from whom?
Dealerships compete blind on one platform.
They don't see rivals' offers—only you do.
No haggling; highest price wins instantly.
One step: upload details and watch bids.
thread_text:
1. Your car, their blind war

Dealerships bid against each other without seeing offers—you watch the price climb from your phone.

2. No one knows the rival

Each dealer sees zero data on competitors. Only you hold the full picture.

3. Haggling is dead

Forget back-and-forth. The top bid locks instantly—no second chances, no negotiation.

4. One upload triggers chaos

In minutes, dealers race to outbid each other. Your car becomes a silent auction.

5. Try it this week

List your car today. Would you rather waste hours at a lot or watch buyers compete for you?
